action.prompt: You are building FrontDesk for Kiroween 2026. Remember the non-negotiables before you write anything: 100% new code in the submission window (never copy from FenBig, AgentMart, or WEPOS); everything in English; never gitignore /.kiro; never present fabricated data as real — every dataset cites its source; sends are simulated in the template, never claim a real SMS was placed; run node --test template/tests/ after each spec task.

hooks.description: Restate the FrontDesk ground rules at the start of every session so no turn drifts from them.
hooks.name: frontdesk-ground-rules
